finding: Over three runs the 1.5B passed every case, and it wrote the answer itself in 17 of 18 covered questions: only the first run of 'How did he handle logging' fell back to a quote. Answers ran 137 to 463 characters, against 45 to 54 in the single bad run.
variance: This supersedes the earlier single run of the same model and settings, which scored 11/14 and declined three covered questions. Same model, same temperature, nine minutes apart. A single run at temperature 0.2 is not a measurement, and this pair is the proof: 11/14 and 42/42 from the same binary.
consequence: The reason to prefer Fast is download size and time to first answer, not accuracy. Accuracy, measured over three runs, belongs to the 1.5B.
